title: Grade 2 Math — Wed, Jun 25
description: Money — Day 3 of 5: Subtracting amounts — giving change problems
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Rohan has ₹10 and spends ₹4. How much is left?
questions.explanation: ₹10 − ₹4 = ₹6. Rohan has six rupees left after spending four rupees.

questions.question: A shopkeeper has ₹20. He gives ₹5 as change. How much is left?
questions.explanation: ₹20 − ₹5 = ₹15. After giving five rupees as change, fifteen rupees remain.

questions.question: Rani had ₹8 and spent ₹3 on a toffee. How much does she have left?
questions.explanation: ₹8 − ₹3 = ₹5. Rani has five rupees left after buying the toffee.

questions.question: A balloon costs ₹5. You give the shopkeeper ₹10. What change do you get?
questions.explanation: ₹10 − ₹5 = ₹5. If you pay ₹10 for a ₹5 balloon, you get ₹5 back as change.

questions.question: Mohan has ₹15. He spends ₹10 on a book. How much is left?
questions.explanation: ₹15 − ₹10 = ₹5. Mohan has five rupees left after buying the book.

questions.question: A pen costs ₹7. You give ₹10. How much change will you receive?
questions.explanation: ₹10 − ₹7 = ₹3. You will receive three rupees as change.

questions.question: Priya has ₹25 and buys a toy for ₹18. How much money is left?
questions.explanation: ₹25 − ₹18 = ₹7. Priya has seven rupees left after buying the toy.

questions.question: A fruit-seller has ₹50. He gives ₹22 as change to a customer. How much is left?
questions.explanation: ₹50 − ₹22 = ₹28. The fruit-seller has twenty-eight rupees left.

questions.question: Suresh had ₹40. He spent ₹16 on snacks. How much does he have now?
A sticker pack costs ₹12. You give a ₹20 note. What is the correct change?
questions.explanation: ₹20 − ₹12 = ₹8. You should receive eight rupees as change.

questions.question: Kavya has ₹30. She buys a notebook for ₹14 and a pencil for ₹3. How much is left?
Amit paid ₹50 for something. He got ₹15 as change. What was the cost of the item?
questions.explanation: Cost = ₹50 − ₹15 = ₹35. The item cost thirty-five rupees.

questions.question: A shopkeeper had ₹100. He gave change of ₹35 to one customer and ₹25 to another. How much is left?
Geeta has ₹80. She buys a dress for ₹55. How much change should she receive if she pays with a ₹100 note?
questions.explanation: She pays ₹100 for an item costing ₹55. Change = ₹100 − ₹55 = ₹45.

questions.question: A toy car costs ₹48. Raj has ₹60. After buying the toy car, does he have enough left to buy a pencil for ₹8?
options: No, he has only ₹10 left which is not enough
questions.explanation: Money after buying car = ₹60 − ₹48 = ₹12. Since ₹12 > ₹8, yes he can buy the pencil.
